decisive_items: 3 x 3 cm sized palpable lump at posterior aspect of right knee joint
Multi-lobulated cyst measuring 3.3 cm × 3.0 cm × 3.9 cm at popliteal fossa
Popliteal artery running on anteromedial side of the cyst
response.rationale: R1 is directly supported by raw spans describing a palpable posterior knee lump and a multi-lobulated popliteal fossa cyst on MRI, matching the classic presentation and imaging of a Baker's cyst. No competing candidate exists, and no raw contradicting spans are present.
